_comment: Mozilla-style JSON update manifest, served raw from this repository's main branch and named by manifest.json's applications.zotero.update_url. Ticket 0688: the URL there was https://example.invalid/..., an RFC 2606 address guaranteed never to resolve, so every update check the plugin made failed against a name chosen to fail. The id keeps its .invalid suffix and correctly so -- Zotero never dereferences an id, only this URL. The updates list is EMPTY on purpose and is the honest answer for a plugin hand-delivered as an XPI: there is no published release to offer, so nothing here may point at a download link that does not exist. Publishing releases means adding an entry per release with update_link and applications.zotero version bounds; until then this file exists so the update check resolves and says 'nothing available' rather than failing on DNS.
